title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For San Bruno | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - San Bruno Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
STATION ELEVATOR
Can't enter station: Take another mode of transportation such as a SamTrans bus to another BART station. The closest station is South San Francisco.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to exit at another station. The closest station is South San Francisco.

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For San Leandro | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - San Leandro Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
PLATFORM 2 ELEVATOR (RICHMOND, SFO/MILLBRAE/DALY CITY DIRECTIONS)
Can't enter station: Take the Platform 1 elevator to the opposite platform. Go back to Bay Fair and board the desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to Coliseum and return to San Leandro. Exit using the Platform 1 elevator.
PLATFORM 1 ELEVATOR (DUBLIN, BERRYESSA DIRECTIONS)
Can't enter station: Take the Platform 2 elevator to the opposite platform. Go back to Coliseum and board the desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to Bay Fair and return to San Leandro. Exit using the Platform 2 elevator.

STREET ELEVATOR 2
Can't enter station: Take the other street elevator.
Can't exit station: Take the other street elevator.
PLATFORM ELEVATOR 1
Can't enter station: Take the other platform elevator.
Can't exit station: Take the other platform elevator.
PLATFORM ELEVATOR 2
Can't enter station: Take the other platform elevator.
Can't exit station: Take the other platform elevator.
PEDESTRIAN BRIDGE ELEVATOR

Can't enter station: Take an alternative mode of transportation to reach the main station entrance on Warm Springs Boulevard (0.8 miles). To walk or roll, proceed north on Lopes Road and turn right on S. Grimmer Boulevard. Then turn right on Warm Springs Boulevard.
Can't exit station: Use the platform elevators inside the station to exit via the main/east side of the station.
